title: David Wilkerson
excerpt: Editorial research draft about David Wilkerson (1931-2011), founder of Teen Challenge, the largest faith-based residential program network in the world. Harms at Teen Challenge since his death are attributed to Teen Challenge.

meta.person_role: Pentecostal preacher; founder of Teen Challenge, World Challenge and Times Square Church

person_notable_work: Founded the largest single program network in the industry
Co-wrote The Cross and the Switchblade
Teen Challenge's 1990s Texas fight produced the modern faith-based licensing exemption
